question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence. What __surrounded__ Lena as she journeyed through the forest?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Freed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"surrounded"** means to be all around someone or something, often creating a feeling of being enclosed. (घेर लिया)

 
 
• **Example: **The army surrounded the enemy camp, cutting off all escape routes.
 
 
 
• **"Freed"** refers to being released from confinement, bondage, or any kind of encirclement; it is the opposite of being surrounded. (मुक्त किया)
 
 
• **Example: **The prisoner was finally freed after years of captivity.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'surrounded'** is **'freed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Freed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Created** (निर्मित किया): Brought something into existence.

 
 
• **Example:** She created a beautiful painting in just two hours.
 
 
 
• **Girded** (कमर कस ली): Encircled or surrounded, especially in preparation for action.
 
 
• **Example:** He girded himself for the upcoming battle.
 
 
 
• **Bolt** (बोल्ट): A metal pin or bar, in this context it is less related but can mean to run away suddenly.
 
 
• **Example:** The horse bolted when it heard the loud noise.
